title: tabular-synthetic-generation
summary: A single-script project generating synthetic tabular data (mixed numerical, categorical, and text features) using standalone CTGAN, with an insurance-cost dataset as its running example. It optionally imports SDV's single-table API, fitting a GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and a CTGANSynthesizer (via SingleTableMetadata) as baselines against the standalone CTGAN model.
